title: decaloba pallida
intro: Decaloba pallida, commonly known as the "White Trumpet" or "Gloriosa," is a flowering plant species in the genus Gloriosa. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues due to its multiple health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and act as an anti-spasmodic. The therapeutic actions of Decaloba pallida are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins. These bioactive constituents, particularly the alkaloids such as colchicine and colchicoside, are responsible for the plant's anti-inflammatory and anti-spasmodic properties.
